metaDescription: Manage client bookings for PR Per Hour administrators.
detailMetaTitleFallback: Booking details | Admin | PR Per Hour
detailMetaDescription: Review and update a booking status, meeting link, and notes.
lead: Review client bookings, update status, meeting links, and shared notes.
scopeBody: Status, meeting link, and notes updates only. Payment, invoices, refunds, rescheduling, calendar sync, and notifications are not available in this UI.
searchHint: Matches client name/email and service title/slug.
filterClientIdHint: Optional numeric user id. There is no client directory in this phase.
detailLead: Shared booking notes are visible to the client. Meeting links open in a new tab.
statusDialogDescription: Current status: {{current}}. Only allowed transitions are listed.
statusTerminalNote: This booking is in a terminal status and cannot be changed further.
statusTransitionHint: Backend rules remain authoritative if a transition is rejected.
meetingLinkDialogDescription: Provide an https URL, or leave empty to clear the link.
meetingLinkHint: Valid URL, max 500 characters. Empty clears the link.
notesDialogDescription: These notes are stored on the booking and may be visible to the client.
notesHint: Plain text, max {{max}} characters. Empty clears notes.
emptyDescription: When clients create bookings, they will appear here.
filteredEmptyDescription: No bookings match these filters. Reset filters to see all bookings.
listErrorDescription: The booking list could not be loaded. Try again.
servicesFilterError: Services could not be loaded for filtering.
detailErrorDescription: This booking could not be loaded. Try again.
detailNotFoundDescription: No booking exists for this link, or it is no longer available.
detailForbiddenDescription: You do not have permission to view this booking.
validationMeetingLinkFormat: Enter a valid http or https URL.
validationMeetingLinkMax: Meeting link must be 500 characters or fewer.
validationNotesMax: Notes must be 5000 characters or fewer.
validationDateRange: From date must be on or before to date.
errorInvalidTransition: That status transition is not allowed.
errorUnauthorized: Your session is not authorized. Sign in again as an admin.
errorForbidden: You do not have permission to manage this booking.
errorConflict: This booking conflicts with another operation.
errorRateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errorNetwork: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errorServer: The server could not complete this request. Try again later.
